title: Smart Data Models - FIBO - RelationshipRecord
description: a record describing relationships between legal entities (FIBO Production 2026Q3 class fibo-be-le-lei:RelationshipRecord, 'relationship record'. Attributes derived from the OWL restrictions on this class and its superclasses cmns-col:Constituent; FIBO property names verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'RelationshipRecord'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

relationshipType.description: Property. Model:'https://smartdatamodels.org/dataModel.FIBO/relationshipType'. Not a FIBO term (Smart Data Models addition): the FIBO LEI property this record is about, as a compact IRI: fibo-be-le-lei:isDirectlyConsolidatedBy (GLEIF IS_DIRECTLY_CONSOLIDATED_BY), fibo-be-le-lei:isUltimatelyConsolidatedBy (IS_ULTIMATELY_CONSOLIDATED_BY) or fibo-be-le-lei:isInternationalBranchOf (IS_INTERNATIONAL_BRANCH_OF).

hasOwnedEntity.description: Relationship. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/OwnershipAndControl/OwnershipParties/hasOwnedEntity'. indicates a formal organization, including potentially a sole proprietorship, that is owned by a legal person. Points to the child LegalEntity (GLEIF StartNode). Flattened from the EntityOwnership that this record records (cmns-doc:records exactly 1 fibo-be-oac-opty:EntityOwnership); FIBO restriction on fibo-be-oac-opty:EntityOwnership: some (fibo-be-le-fbo:NotForProfitOrganization or fibo-be-le-lp:BusinessEntity or cmns-org:LegalEntity).

hasOwningEntity.description: Relationship. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/OwnershipAndControl/OwnershipParties/hasOwningEntity'. indicates a party that owns a formal organization. Points to the parent LegalEntity (GLEIF EndNode). Flattened from the EntityOwnership that this record records (cmns-doc:records exactly 1 fibo-be-oac-opty:EntityOwnership); FIBO restriction on fibo-be-oac-opty:EntityOwnership: some cmns-org:LegalPerson.

isClassifiedBy.description: Property. Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Classifiers/isClassifiedBy'. is systematically grouped based on characteristics by. Values: FIBO individuals of fibo-be-le-lei:RelationshipStatus as compact IRIs: fibo-be-le-lei:RelationshipStatusActive (relationship status - active); fibo-be-le-lei:RelationshipStatusInactive (relationship status - inactive). GLEIF RelationshipStatus (ACTIVE / INACTIVE). Flattened from the EntityOwnership that this record records (cmns-doc:records exactly 1 fibo-be-oac-opty:EntityOwnership); FIBO restriction on fibo-be-oac-opty:EntityOwnership: exactly 1 fibo-be-le-lei:RelationshipStatus.

holdsDuring.description: Property. Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/holdsDuring'. indicates a date period during which something is true. GLEIF RelationshipPeriods: the relationship period has no qualifier; accounting and document filing periods carry isQualifiedBy. Flattened from the EntityOwnership that this record records (cmns-doc:records exactly 1 fibo-be-oac-opty:EntityOwnership); FIBO restriction on cmns-pts:Situation: min 0 cmns-dt:DatePeriod.

hasOwnershipPercentage.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/LegalEntities/LEIEntities/hasOwnershipPercentage'. the percentage ownership interest in the owned entity owned by owning entity, if known. Units:'P1'. Flattened from the EntityOwnership that this record records (cmns-doc:records exactly 1 fibo-be-oac-opty:EntityOwnership); FIBO restriction on fibo-be-oac-opty:EntityOwnership: min 0 xsd:decimal.

isQualifiedBy.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Agreements/Contracts/isQualifiedBy'. indicates a constraint, limitation or refinement on something. Values: FIBO individuals of fibo-be-le-lei:AccountingFramework as compact IRIs: fibo-be-le-lei:GenerallyAcceptedAccountingPrinciples (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles); fibo-be-le-lei:InternationalFinancialReportingStandard (International Financial Reporting Standard); fibo-be-le-lei:OtherAccountingFramework (other accounting framework). GLEIF RelationshipQualifiers (accounting standard). FIBO restriction: fibo-be-le-lei:RelationshipRecord min 0 fibo-be-le-lei:RelationshipQualifier.

isQuantifiedBy.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/LegalEntities/LEIEntities/isQuantifiedBy'. indicates that something is limited to or conditional due to some rate or other statistical value. GLEIF RelationshipQuantifiers (e.g. accounting consolidation or ownership percentage). FIBO restriction: fibo-be-le-lei:RelationshipRecord min 0 xsd:decimal.

DatePeriod.description: OMG Commons cmns-dt:DatePeriod, nested: time span over one or more calendar days. Properties from its restrictions.

hasStartDate.description: Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/DatesAndTimes/hasStartDate'. indicates the initial date associated with something

hasEndDate.description: Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/DatesAndTimes/hasEndDate'. indicates the final or ending date associated with something

isQualifiedBy.description: Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Agreements/Contracts/isQualifiedBy'. indicates a constraint, limitation or refinement on something Here: the period qualifier (fibo-be-le-lei:RelationshipPeriodQualifier): fibo-be-le-lei:AccountingPeriod (accounting period); fibo-be-le-lei:DocumentFilingPeriod (document filing period). Omitted for the relationship period itself.
